note: Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1 (six evaluations including AA-Paperclip, per AA's methodology version history): a composite index testing decision models across document decisions and extraction, tool calling, knowledge, reasoning and invariance. Scores are the rounded integers AA displays (JS Math.round of the payload's indexScore floats). The 16 rows mirror AA's default decision-model chart selection (contestants with kind=decisionModel and isDefault=true), excluding language-model baselines (Claude Haiku 5.5 (Low), GPT-6 Luna (Low)) and two maintainer exclusions under the cheap/fast-dominated rule from v1.0: Decider Flash v1.3 (64) and Drex 2.0 (62). Variants AA unselected as superseded are dropped (d1, d1.1, d1-ultra, Microsoft-Decision-1, Decider Flash v1.2, Decider v1.2, SubQ Snap 1.1). Provider changes vs v1.0: Baseten is now Base Labs per AA's creatorName (color #A0D7FE); Google joins with Gemini Decision 1 and keeps its ai.json palette color (#34A853). Liquid AI, Subquadratic, Nace.AI, and Fastino keep their brand colors per the commit-time color rule (AA still ships #000000 for the latter three). The v1.0 rows are archived in decision-2026-11-04.json; every row carries a per-row aa_version so the dashboard's version selector can show either index version.
